PGDATA.description: Filesystem path where PostgreSQL stores its data files.

PGHOST.description: PostgreSQL server hostname on the private network.

PGUSER.description: PostgreSQL username used in connection strings.

PGDATABASE.description: PostgreSQL database name used in connection strings.

PGPASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password used in connection strings.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database name created on initialization.

DATABASE_URL.description: Internal PostgreSQL connection URL for service-to-service communication.

SSL_CERT_DAYS.description: Number of days until the auto-generated SSL certificate expires.

DATABASE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public PostgreSQL connection URL via TCP proxy for external access.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds to wait before stopping the previous deployment during a rollout.

AGENT_CONTROL_DB_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection URL with psycopg driver. References the managed postgres service.

AGENT_CONTROL_PORT.description: Server listen port. Uses Railway-assigned PORT for external routing.

AGENT_CONTROL_API_KEY_ENABLED.description: Enable API key authentication. Should remain enabled in production.

AGENT_CONTROL_API_KEYS.description: Auto-generated API key for runtime and read access. Save this value for SDK and API clients.

AGENT_CONTROL_ADMIN_API_KEYS.description: Auto-generated admin API key for control-plane mutations and UI login. Save this value.

AGENT_CONTROL_SESSION_SECRET.description: Secret for session encryption. Auto-generated; do not change after first deploy.

AGENT_CONTROL_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Allowed CORS origins for the bundled dashboard served from the server public domain. Generate a public domain on the server service before first use.

GALILEO_API_KEY.description: Optional Galileo API key for the Luna-2 AI evaluator.
